description: This file defines the EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao class which provides data access methods for retrieving employee attendance records, such as latest attendance, attendance within a date range, and open attendance records, from the database in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for employee time tracking records, specifically for retrieving attendance data based on employee number and date ranges.

methods.name: getLatestAttendanceRecordByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent attendance record for a given employee based on punch-in time.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsByEmployeeAndDate
methods.description: Fetches all attendance records for a specified employee within a given date and time range, considering punch-in and punch-out times.

methods.name: getOpenAttendanceRecordByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the current open (punched in but not punched out) attendance record for the specified employee.
